reason: I already paid a developer and a portal before and got almost nothing back, so Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month to a small remote studio with one website to its name is too big a bet on a promise. My quotes go out fine by hand from my Excel sheet, even if it is slow.
objection: Who is going to keep my price list correct every time raw material rates move? If the quote desk sends a wrong rate, or the studio disappears after taking 40%, I am the one who loses money and face with the buyer.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try the quote desk on my own Excel price list for a month first, before paying for any website, and let me talk to that chemical-trading client to hear if it actually brought them orders.
